canonical_actual_test_execution_false_se: The reused adapter flag describes its saved-only analysis operation, not absence of native evaluation. Exact all22 exit0/closed-log/output witnesses and canonical execution receipt bind already executed native final100 outputs.
cost_contract: Actual stored token_ids and elapsed_seconds only. Timed generate_record spans include its prompt/image/hash/cache work and inside-call resource callbacks or HOLD waits; initial model loading and outer JSON write/flush overhead are excluded. These are elapsed call times, not pure GPU time. Missing elapsed data remains unavailable. EOS stop at the cap is not classified as length truncation.
generalization_limitations: Question/class recount is descriptive. Canonical patient/cycle and between-seed limitations remain unchanged; no clinical or global cross-source independence claim.
metric_contract: Existing _answer_and_format: native correctness requires format>0 and exact allowed label ignoring case; full-format correctness additionally requires format==1. No parser or threshold change.
